verdict.rationale: The SOS publishes its own task guidance beyond forms: a Business Filings Guide and How-to Videos for filing on SOSPortal, plus per-form instructions alongside the forms directory. The evidence shows only titles and links, though, so whether this guidance is plain-language and step-by-step for a non-lawyer is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence that the content is written in plain language rather than statute-referencing form instructions, step-by-step founder explainers beyond portal mechanics (e.g., choosing an entity type, end-to-end formation walkthrough), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of usability.
